messages:
Maya (CS): Hey team — CedarBio asked for a week-long enablement series (3 sessions) to cover Dedicated migration, API best practices, and monitoring. They want next month and need APAC-friendly times. Can we lock slots?
Arjun (Enable): I can lead the migration session. Prefer late-EMEA / early-APAC to catch both EU and APAC engineers. Proposed slots: Tue 09:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST / 02:00 AEST, Wed 13:00 PDT / 21:00 CEST / 06:00 AEST, Thu 22:00 PDT / 06:00 CEST / 15:00 AEST. Thoughts?
Priya (Solutions): Thanks — those are helpful. CedarBio flagged a renewal risk if uptake doesn't improve; we should prioritize the Dedicated migration session and tie it to a migration playbook walkthrough and Q&A. Tom (AE): noted renewal signal; can we make the migration session the first of the three?
Maya (CS): Yes, make migration session #1. Arjun, can you do Wed slot (the mid-day PDT / morning APAC one)? That will let our US PM join too.
Arjun (Enable): I can do Wed (the 13:00 PDT / 21:00 CEST / 06:00 AEST option) but need a co-facilitator for the live demo. Priya, you ok to run the demo portion?
Priya (Solutions): I can do demo for 30m. I'll prepare a short checklist and a sample infra repo. Will drop docs link in thread.
Nina (CS Intern): Quick poll to confirm attendee timezones — should we run a 2-minute Doodle or just send three calendar invites and let them pick?
Tom (AE): Send invites with RSVP and only keep ones >5 RSVPs. For strategic accounts like CedarBio we should also capture post-session NPS and a migration readiness form. Can we add that to the invite?
Maya (CS): Yes — add the short form. Suggested fields: current infra (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), blocker topics (latency, auth, cost), migration ETA.
Lee (CalendarBot): Created 3 provisional invites:
- Wed session (migration): 3845048400 (13:00 PDT / 21:00 CEST / Thu 06:00 AEST)
- Thu session (API best practices): 3845134800 (22:00 PDT / 06:00 CEST / Fri 15:00 AEST)
- Fri session (monitoring + runbooks): 3845221200 (09:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST / Sat 02:00 AEST)
(Use /calendar confirm <id> to finalize) :calendar:
Arjun (Enable): Wed slot ID? I'll ask infra SME to block calendar.
Lee (CalendarBot): Wed session invite id: 8272-wed-migration. Draft invite body attached below.
Priya (Solutions): Draft invite body looks good. Add link to migration playbook and 15-min pre-session drop-in for engineers to set up token and demo workspace.
Maya (CS): Also capture a pre-workshop checklist in the invite and ask attendees to upload a network diagram if possible. That will speed up the Q&A and reduce post-session churn (renewal risk mitigation).
Tom (AE): I'll include a line in the account steering doc that these sessions are tied to a 30-day success plan. If attendance and action items are met, we push for renewal conversation.
Arjun (Enable): For feedback capture, let's use a single Typeform with three required questions + 2 optional. I can share template. Post-session, we'll tag follow-ups in Gainsight and assign owners.
Nina (CS Intern): Do you want me to create the Typeform and the short migration readiness checklist? I can draft and drop in #docs by EOD.
Maya (CS): Yes please, Nina. Assign owner fields: Arjun (technical follow-ups), Priya (integration follow-ups), Tom (commercial/renewal).
Priya (Solutions): One more ask — can we record sessions and auto-upload to the CedarBio shared workspace? Means less friction for their wider team.
Lee (CalendarBot): Recording option enabled on all invites. Auto-upload: disabled by default (privacy). Please confirm if CedarBio consented to recordings.
Tom (AE): They did consent in Slack thread with their legal contact (see link: https://cedarbio.example.com/consent). Proceed.
Maya (CS): Great. Action items:
- Arjun: co-facilitate migration session + share Typeform template (due: 3 days)
- Priya: prepare demo repo + checklist (due: 4 days)
- Nina: create Typeform + readiness checklist draft (due: EOD)
- Tom: update steering doc & confirm legal consent copy (due: 2 days)
- Lee (CalendarBot): finalize invites on /calendar confirm 8272-wed-migration after Arjun says go
Please react with :thumbsup: if that timeline works or drop conflicts.
Priya (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Arjun (Enable): :thumbsup: locking Wed for migration, I'll block infra SME.
Tom (AE): :thumbsup: will follow up on legal doc copy.
Maya (CS): Thanks all — will post final invite + agenda when Arjun confirms.
